Version Management Enhancement Summary

Source: VERSION_MANAGEMENT_SUMMARY.md

Overview

This enhancement allows users to work with timestamped and backup files that the boilerplate package creates, addressing a significant gap where these files couldn’t be imported.

Key New Functions

  1. boilerplate_list_files()
    • Lists all database files (standard, timestamped, backups)
    • Organised display with file metadata
    • Filterable by category or pattern
  2. boilerplate_import_enhanced()
    • Import specific timestamped versions
    • Import latest timestamped files
    • Import from backup files
    • Maintains backward compatibility
  3. boilerplate_restore_backup()
    • Convenience function for backup restoration
    • Option to overwrite current database
    • Clear workflow for recovery scenarios

Implementation Strategy

  1. Keep existing functions unchanged - No breaking changes
  2. Add new enhanced functions - Extended capabilities
  3. Use consistent naming - Clear relationship to existing functions
  4. Maintain simplicity - Don’t allow arbitrary filenames

Use Cases Addressed

  • ✅ Import timestamped files created by boilerplate_save(timestamp = TRUE)
  • ✅ Recover from automatic backups
  • ✅ Compare versions over time
  • ✅ Track database evolution
  • ✅ Manage multiple versions without manual file manipulation

Documentation Updates Required

  1. README.md - Add “Managing Database Versions” section
  2. Getting Started vignette - Add version management examples
  3. Function documentation - Cross-reference new functions
  4. pkgdown site - New “Version Management” section
  5. NEWS.md - Document new features
